name: Composio
description: Connect Gmail, Slack, GitHub, Notion, and 1000+ other apps via Composio. One workspace user_id is shared by every Bot.

tools.name: status
tools.description: Show whether Composio is connected and which workspace user_id this swarm uses.

tools.name: list_toolkits
tools.description: List available Composio app toolkits (gmail, github, slack, notion, ...).

tools.name: search_tools
tools.description: Search Composio tools by what you want to do, e.g. 'gmail send' or 'github issues'.

tools.name: connect
tools.description: Start an OAuth/connect flow for a toolkit (gmail, github, slack, notion, ...). Returns a URL the human must open.

tools.name: execute
tools.description: Run a Composio tool by slug (from search_tools), e.g. GMAIL_SEND_EMAIL. Use request_approval first for sends, deletes, or purchases.
